tools.name: list_files

tools.name: search_text

kind.description: Optional. Omit or product for a UI/UX or product question. handoff for a mandatory authentication or security handoff. Any other explicit kind is rejected.

tools.description: Submit the review: verdict approve or changes, with findings.
tools.name: submit_review

tools.description: The project's setup commands, fixers, checks and protected verification configuration; dependency-only manifests and lockfiles are ineligible.
tools.name: submit_configuration

tools.description: Terminate with nonempty evidence and files [{path,content}]; read/probe files empty, draft only owns.
